limitations: Browser verification confirms visible rendering and sampled displayed values, not the storage origin of each network response; hosted API and provenance checks are recorded separately.
This was a desktop viewport review, not a mobile, accessibility, or capacity test.
No refresh-data controls, administration routes, forms, saved views, or other data mutations were invoked.
One browser scroll gesture reported a tool timeout after scrolling had occurred; a subsequent screenshot verified the resulting viewport without repeating the gesture.
Screenshots are transient review intermediates in scratch and are not repository assets.
